name: ownership
purpose: A CODEOWNERS file with a catch-all, a nested directory rule with two owners on it, an overlapping rule where last-match-wins decides, and a character-class pattern this version refuses. Owned and unowned subjects must both be present and correct.
exercises: owned subject with more than one owner, one edge per owner token
explicitly unowned subjects with an evaluated policy
an unsupported pattern surfaced rather than approximated, with its neighbours still applying
